## Purpose and boundary

The Flowline Points step turns exact saved Reach Flowlines into the
terrain-sampled longitudinal point profile used by later FluvialGeomorph
analysis. FG Studio automates choices already expressed during Stream and Reach
definition: the analyst does not select line segments, set direction, choose
measure fields, or browse for a DEM again.

This implementation qualifies and extends the existing
`fluvgeo::flowline_points()` path developed through `ohwm2`; it does not replace
that path. Existing `ohwm2` callers retain their metre `POINT_M` behavior. FG
Studio calls `study_area_flowline_points()` to obtain the legacy ArcPy-
replacement profile in kilometers across every connected Stream and ordered
Reach in one Study Area reference frame.

The present boundary is current/base-event creation and local immutable review.
Comparison-event calibration, acceptance of an FGDB longitudinal reference
frame, and governed publication remain later work.

## Function flow

1. `flowline_points_review_server()` resolves the selected Survey Event and
   every included Stream from the shared study context.
2. `load_flowline_points_review()` opens each exact saved Hydro revision,
   Stream segment evidence, and Reach Flowline candidate. Missing prerequisites
   identify the Stream and route back to the responsible tab.
3. The create action passes all saved Reach lines, Hydro rasters, and Stream
   corridors to `fluvgeo::study_area_flowline_points()`. The default maximum
   spacing is one metre; existing Flowline vertices are retained.
4. The backend identifies the sole Study outlet, derives each tributary parent
   from prior Stream Definition, projects tributary outlets onto downstream
   Flowlines, and propagates confluence measures through the acyclic graph. It
   samples every point, constructs all legacy fields, and calls
   `check_flowline_points(..., "fgstudio_replacement")`.
5. `study_flowline_points_store()` rechecks current inputs, writes an immutable
   candidate, hashes the GeoPackage, and reopens the result through the same
   validation boundary used on later sessions.
6. Stream tabs display the selected Reach lines, bounded point sample, and
   dynamically stretched Hydro DEM. The longitudinal graph always displays all
   Study Area Streams and Reaches on their common mouth-based x-axis.

Leaflet can initialize while its tab is hidden and before the map container has
its final width. A display-only resize observer corrects the map when its visible
dimensions become available; this browser lifecycle detail does not appear as a
workflow control.

Changing the advanced spacing input does not rerun sampling. A new candidate is
created only by the explicit button action. Creation and viewport work expose
visible progress so a long operation does not appear hung.

## Compatibility profile

The GeoPackage layer name is `flowline_points`. These exact historical fields
are retained:

- `ReachName`
- `POINT_X`
- `POINT_Y`
- `POINT_M`
- `POINT_M_uncalibrated`
- `calibration_diff`
- `Z`

The existing downstream field `km_to_mouth` is also retained. In the FG Studio
replacement profile, all measure and calibration fields use kilometers. For an
uncalibrated base profile, `POINT_M_uncalibrated == POINT_M`,
`calibration_diff == 0`, and `km_to_mouth == POINT_M`.

Additive fields carry stable Stream and Reach identity/order, the downstream
Stream, confluence and Stream offsets, distance from each Reach start and Stream
outlet, station spacing, Study Area origin, frame scope, and explicit units.
Shared Reach endpoints occur once for each owning Reach with the same measure.
The validator admits machine-precision roundoff at this equality while rejecting
a meaningful downstream reversal.

`cross_section()` now uses explicit `POINT_M_units` when supplied. Absence of
that field retains the established metre assumption, protecting existing
`ohwm2` behavior; an explicit FG Studio kilometer profile is not multiplied by
`0.001` a second time.

## Data objects and storage

The operation reads one Study revision, local Survey Event definition, every
included Stream corridor, Hydro revision, saved Reach Flowline revision, Reach
mapping, and station spacing. It writes a Study-scoped
`flowline-points/<revision>` directory containing:

- `flowline-points.gpkg`, layers `flowline_points` and
  `stream_connections`;
- `result.rds`, the internal completion/reopen index; and
- `provenance.json`, the human-readable input and result record.

Study-scoped placement is intentional. The Hydro, Stream Network, and Flowline
stores already create a deep immutable lineage, and nesting another revision
there exceeds the 260-character path limit encountered by Windows `fs`/GDAL.
The candidate remains exactly bound through hashes of the Study, Event, every
Hydro output and every Flowline GeoPackage plus their revision identities. A
`PENDING` marker prevents incomplete writes from reopening; the output hash and
both required layers are verified on read.

This is a durable preparation asset, not an accepted FGDB Dataset Edition or
longitudinal reference frame. The portable layer contract remains aligned with
the legacy toolbox while the future FGDB binding is developed.

## Real-data acceptance

The saved Spencer Creek 2019-12 Study was processed through the same backend as
one connected network:

| Stream | Reaches | Points at 1 m | Start measure | End measure | Connection gap |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Spencer Creek mainstem | 5 | 34,517 | 0.000 km | 20.935 km | outlet |
| east unnamed trib | 3 | 14,360 | 1.523 km | 10.111 km | 0.166 m |
| west unnamed trib | 3 | 11,870 | 7.726 km | 14.809 km | 1.910 m |

The 60,747-point result was generated in 13.72 seconds on the development
workstation. The connections pass the 2.828 m two-cell-diagonal limit for these
one-meter Hydro DEMs. The combined profile satisfies the replacement validator and
reopens from immutable storage. Each Stream map limits rendering to a
deterministic sample of at most 5,000 points; this affects display only, not
saved content or the full Study Area profile plot.

## Source and test route

- App UI/orchestration: `R/flowline_points_review.R`
- Persistence: `R/flowline_points_store.R`, composed by `R/study_store.R`
- Navigation: `R/mod_study.R`
- App tests: `tests/testthat/test-flowline-points-review.R` and
  `tests/testthat/test-flowline-points-store.R`
- Shared producer/validator: `fluvgeo/R/flowline_points.R` and
  `fluvgeo/R/check_flowline_points.R`
- Shared regression tests: `test_reach_flowline_points.R`,
  `test_check_flowline_points.R`, and `test_cross_section.R`

For schema changes, first follow the repository's legacy-derived-feature
compatibility workflow and the sibling FGDB compatibility profile. New fields
may be additive; historical fields and meanings are not optional.
